name: etymon
description: A portable environment manager for coding agent skills, MCP servers, agents, and rules

scripts.test:coverage: npm run build && npx --yes --package c8@12.0.0 c8 --all --src src --include 'src/**/*.ts' --extension .ts --exclude-after-remap --check-coverage --lines 70 --statements 70 --branches 65 --functions 80 --reporter text --reporter html --reporter lcov --reporter json-summary node scripts/coverage-run.mjs
scripts.check: npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm test && npm run build
scripts.format: prettier --write src tests testcases bin scripts package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts README.md docs .github
scripts.format:check: prettier --check src tests testcases bin scripts package.json tsconfig.json vitest.config.ts README.md docs .github
